numerical_claims: Hypothetical example: 600 tasks completed in an hour against capacity of 1,000 tasks in that hour gives U = 0.60 (60%). With demand of 600 tasks/hour, Load = 0.60 and Rcapacity = 1.67. Neither ratio is a profitability threshold.

Hypothetical example: C0 = $300,000, annual avoidable labor cash cost = $120,000, annual incremental operating cash cost = $20,000, and no other benefits. S = $100,000/year. Simple payback is 3 years. At H = 5 years, ROI_H = ($500,000 − $300,000)/$300,000 = 66.7%. This is a worked example, not a client result or a recommended hurdle rate.

Method reference: NIST AMS 200-11, Appendix A1.3, printed pages 25–27 distinguishes payback time, uniform and uneven cash flows, and the limitations of payback.
